lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight increase in density toward the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 5th stripe from the posterior, branching downward at the mid-torso level.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st, 2nd, 10th, and 11th vertical lines are truncated segments that do not reach the dorsal or ventral boundaries of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4-5 white spots is localized on the lower posterior haunch above the hind leg junction.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a secondary boundary indicator below the main stripe pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron pattern on the bridge of the muzzle and isolated white spots on the mid-cheek; white 'sock' markings are present on the distal portion of all visible limbs.
